## Final rebar-debug report

**Problem.** The serial suite failed at `test_cloud_functions_degrade_without_marklas` only after the round-trip integration fixture had run; isolated runs were green.

**Proven root cause.** `tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_roundtrip.py::_load_module` unconditionally replaced the canonical `sys.modules["rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira.adf"]`. `AdfCodec` retained the prior module object A, while the fixture installed B. The later test monkeypatched `B._marklas`, but `AdfCodec.to_wire()` continued calling A, yielding rich ADF from the codec and plain ADF from the direct function.

**Proof.** Runtime identity instrumentation observed A canonical before the fixture and distinct B afterward. The discriminating matrix followed A exclusively: A=None/B=None -> plain; A=real/B=None -> rich mismatch; A=None/B=real -> plain. Restoring the canonical key to A made the unchanged three-node reproduction green, rejecting hidden marklas cache/state and confirming module replacement as the mechanism.

**Test.** Added `test_by_path_loader_preserves_module_identity_for_the_same_source`. Its frozen contract is one module object per canonical name/source pair, while a different source under the same name remains replaceable. It was observed RED before repair, GREEN afterward, and deleting exactly the three-line cache-first guard returned it to RED. Restoring the guard returned it to GREEN. The oracle asserts public runtime identity/output, so behavior-preserving refactors do not invalidate it. Collected: yes; executed: yes; gate: pytest/full suite.

**Fix.** `_load_module` now returns the cached module only when both canonical name and `__file__` match the requested source. Different-source replacement is preserved as the negative control. Commit: `faa2bd881f84da5c06880282d81f4c3ddba2f2b5`.

**Scope and safety.** The bounded caller sweep found four local consumers; none relies on a fresh object, so all are incidental. The change restores the documented canonical-module identity invariant, adds no dependency, and weakens no existing test. Only the integration test-infrastructure file changed.

**Verification and replication.** Focused affected modules: 79 passed. Exact integration-before-unit order: 2767 passed in 137.13s. The original minimal order now passes. `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass. The repository pre-commit hook also passed lint, typecheck, commit-message, and hygiene gates under the worktree virtualenv.

**Siblings.** Construct axis: the existing broad loader-hardening ticket `actinide-possible-scarab` (`e351-537e-a9ca-4669`) covers remaining by-path loader instances and is linked `discovered_from`. Parity axis: N/A because this is test-infrastructure-only, not an operation exposed through CLI/API/library/automation/dual-direction surfaces. Same-source and different-source behavior are both covered by the oracle.

**Residual risk and prevention.** The broader family of unguarded by-path loaders remains intentionally out of this localized fix and is dispositioned to `actinide-possible-scarab`. No other undispositioned fragility was observed.
